title: How a Godly Man Builds a Friendship That Could Survive a Confession
caption:
Most friendships stay comfortable because nobody's said anything real yet.

A group chat isn't a brother. A podcast host isn't a brother. A brother is the guy who'd still pick up the phone after you told him the thing you'd rather keep hidden.

Say the true thing before it gets forced out of you. Show up on the Tuesday that costs you something. Let him see you fail before you tell him you're fine.

That's the friendship that could survive a confession. Go build one.
